description: This file defines the RejectedPromise class in the GuzzleHttp\Promise namespace, representing a promise that has been rejected. It provides methods for handling rejection, chaining, and retrieving the rejection state.

classes.name: RejectedPromise
classes.description: A class representing a promise that has been rejected, implementing PromiseInterface, with methods to handle rejection and state queries.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructs a RejectedPromise with a given reason. Throws an exception if the reason is a promise object.

methods.name: then
methods.description: Adds rejection and fulfillment handlers to the promise, returning a new promise or self if no rejection handler is provided.

methods.name: otherwise
methods.description: Adds a rejection handler to the promise.

methods.name: wait
methods.description: Waits for the promise to settle, throwing an exception if unwrapped, or returning null otherwise.

methods.name: getState
methods.description: Returns the current state of the promise, which is REJECTED.

methods.name: resolve
methods.description: Throws an exception if called, since a rejected promise cannot be resolved.

methods.name: reject
methods.description: Throws an exception if attempting to reject a promise that is already rejected.

methods.name: cancel
methods.description: Method to cancel the promise; here it does nothing.
